criteria.text: Signing up with an email already in use returns the error "email taken" and creates no second account.
Emails are compared case-insensitively at signup and at login.
After 5 failed logins within 15 minutes the account is locked for 30 minutes.
A locked account cannot log in even with the correct password.
A password reset token expires after 1 hour.
A reset token can be used only once.
Changing the password ends all other active sessions of the user but keeps the current one.
Admins can unlock a locked account; non-admins get PermissionDenied.
Sessions expire after 8 hours of inactivity.
